confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Kolkata prices, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors (inexpensive meal, mid-range meal for two, coffee) are the most reliable. Beer, cocktail and wine are less certain because alcohol pricing varies with licensing, state excise and venue type, and they are set against the restaurant anchors. Hotel and hostel anchors are the least certain, since July is monsoon season and accommodation rates move with demand. FX: the 0.6955 figure for 2026-10-15 came from search-result summaries, which conflicted (one result showed only March 2026 rows on the RBA page). I did not open or verify the RBA table itself, so confirm the observation on rba.gov.au before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against general South Asian metro pricing, with Kolkata placed below Delhi and Mumbai for accommodation and dining and in line with other mid-sized Indian tourist cities for local food and cafés. Alcohol is priced relative to the restaurant anchors because direct local knowledge is weaker.
